item.description:
Thimble 0.2.0 adds encrypted sync, a command line, and a Dashboard for your projects.
- Sync through a folder you choose, such as one in iCloud Drive or Dropbox. Everything in it is encrypted with your passphrase, so whoever holds the folder can't read your tasks. A safety copy is kept each day sync is on. - Project cards: say where each project stands on each platform, with its version and last release. A heading named for a version, such as 0.2.0, shows how much of it is done. - The Dashboard compares every project with a card: open tasks, what needs you, what's blocked, what has stalled for 30 days, and what closed this week. - Copy Release Notes, in a version heading's menu, copies its finished tasks as Markdown. - A task now remembers when it last changed, and can wait on other tasks. A waiting task shows an hourglass. - The `thimble` command lets Claude Code and other tools read and change your lists through the running app. It's off until you turn it on in Settings > Privacy, it answers only you on this Mac, and each command is one Undo.
Your tasks stay on your devices. The app's only connection is the update check; sync goes through the folder you pick.
